_doc: Secretariat disposition record (authored input, findings-W2 §2). One record per register id. accept: expect_in_v2 MUST equal the register's proposed_change; modify: modified_text is recorded and expect_in_v2 MUST equal it; reject: no edits. 'via_branch' = resolved through that PR branch (merged with a Resolves: trailer); otherwise applied by script on main. containment: 'element' (default; the v2 counterpart of the resolved v1 element, via C2.4), 'range' (union of the from..to counterparts), 'insert' (new element found in v2 by text, exactly one match). Q7 has no slot for ISO 'noted'; a comment needing no change is dispositioned reject (stated in RESULT.md).
